name: Kill Your Boss
source:
You are a CIA agent who has been ordered to infiltrate a criminal organization. In a brutal world where you can trust no one, you must be ready to betray anyone, anytime. ...Even if it's the person you love.

[From in-app]
translation:
你是一名美国中央情报局特工，奉命潜入犯罪组织。在这个残酷、无人可信的世界里，你必须随时准备，背叛任何人。……哪怕，对方是你的爱人。

[摘自应用内]
